passage: SEC. 100018. AMENDMENT TO AUTHORITY TO APPLY FOR ASYLUM. Section 208(d)(3) (8 U.S.C. 1158(d)(3)) is amended-- (1) in the first sentence, by striking ``may'' and inserting ``shall''; (2) by striking ``Such fees shall not exceed'' and all that follows and inserting the following: ``Nothing in this paragraph may be construed to limit the authority of the Attorney General to set additional adjudication and naturalization fees in accordance with section 286(m).''. PART II--IMMIGRATION AND LAW ENFORCEMENT FUNDING
